translationRepairs: He also sent Langjiang Erzhu Huan and Xiaowei Qiao Gongshan to deliver armor to Wengan.
He also sent Gentleman-General Erzhu Huan and Commandant Qiao Gongshan to deliver armor to Wengan.
郎將 and 校尉 are office titles left untranslated as "Langjiang" and "Xiaowei"; idiomatic renderings are Gentleman-General and Commandant.
Simo was Jieli's younger cousin on the father's side.
Simo was Jieli's paternal uncle of the cousin line (a cousin of Jieli's father).
從叔 means a father's male cousin, one generation above Jieli; the draft wrongly renders it "younger cousin on the father's side".
On dingyou, Left Pushe Pei Ji was sent as envoy to the Turks.
On dingyou, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Pei Ji was sent as envoy to the Turks.
左僕射 is the office of Left Vice Director of State Affairs; "Left Pushe" leaves it untranslated.
On dinghai, Right Weida General Zhang Jin was made campaign commander to resist him, with Secretariat Vice-Director Wen Yanbo as chief clerk.
On dinghai, Grand General of the Right Guard Zhang Jin was made campaign commander to resist him, with Secretariat Vice-Director Wen Yanbo as chief clerk.
右衛大將軍 is Grand General of the Right Guard; "Right Weida General" is a garbled transliteration.
On guimao, Prince of Qin Li Shimin was additionally appointed Palace Director, and Prince of Qi Li Yuanji was made Palace Attendant.
On guimao, Prince of Qin Li Shimin was additionally appointed Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Qi Li Yuanji was made Palace Attendant.
中書令 is Director of the Secretariat; the draft mistranslates it as "Palace Director".
On jiayin, Left Vice Minister of Works Pei Ji was appointed Minister of Works; each day one exterior department official was assigned on rotating duty at his residence.
On jiayin, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Pei Ji was appointed Minister of Works; each day one exterior department official was assigned on rotating duty at his residence.
左僕射 is Left Vice Director of State Affairs, not "Left Vice Minister of Works".
On xinchou, Prince of Shu Li Yuan Gui was redesignated Prince of Wu, and Prince of Han Li Yuan Qing was redesignated Prince of Chen.
On xinchou, Prince of Shu Li Yuangui was redesignated Prince of Wu, and Prince of Han Li Yuanqing was redesignated Prince of Chen.
元軌 and 元慶 are given names romanized as single words, Yuangui and Yuanqing.
In spring, the first month, on jihai, an edict ordered Grand Music Master Vice Director Zu Xiaosun and others to revise the court music.
In spring, the first month, on jihai, an edict ordered Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Zu Xiaosun and others to revise the court music.
太常少卿 is Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, not a music office.
In the fifth month, on wuzi, Hu Cheng Lang and others of Qian Prefecture killed the chief clerk and rebelled, going over to Liang Shidu;
In the fifth month, on wuzi, Hu Chenglang and others of Qian Prefecture killed the chief clerk and rebelled, going over to Liang Shidu;
胡成郎 is a single personal name, romanized Hu Chenglang.

Jiancheng summoned Shimin at night for wine and poisoned him; Shimin was seized with violent heart pain and vomited several sheng of blood; Prince of Huai'an Li Shen Tong helped him back to the Western Palace.

Jiancheng summoned Shimin at night for wine and poisoned him; Shimin was seized with violent heart pain and vomited several sheng of blood; Prince of Huai'an Li Shentong helped him back to the Western Palace.
神通 is a single given name, romanized Shentong.
On renchen, the Qiang tribes raided Kuo Prefecture.
On renchen, the Tangut raided Kuo Prefecture.
党項 is the Tangut, not the Qiang.

On bingwu, Tuyuhun and the Tangut raided He Prefecture.
党項 is the Tangut, not the Qiang.

Route-area Director of Examination of Merit Fang Xuanling said to Director of the Revenue Bureau Changsun Wuji, "The breach is already complete; once disaster strikes in secret, it will not be the Qin Palace alone that is ruined but the whole realm;

Route-area Director of Examination of Merit Fang Xuanling said to Director of the Bureau of Review Changsun Wuji, "The breach is already complete; once disaster strikes in secret, it will not be the Qin Palace alone that is ruined but the whole realm;
比部郎中 heads the Bureau of Review (audit) in the Ministry of Justice, not a revenue bureau.
Zhang Gongjian, a man of great strength, alone barred the gate against them, and they could not get through.
Zhang Gongjin, a man of great strength, alone barred the gate against them, and they could not get through.
張公謹 is Zhang Gongjin; "Gongjian" misspells 謹.
Assistant Guard Cavalry General Feng Li of Fufeng, hearing that Jiancheng was dead, sighed and said, "How can one accept his grace in life and then flee his peril in death?"
Assistant Guard Cavalry General Feng Li of Fengyi, hearing that Jiancheng was dead, sighed and said, "How can one accept his grace in life and then flee his peril in death?"
馮翊 is Fengyi, not Fufeng (扶風).
Shimin knelt and pretended to nurse at the emperor's breast, weeping bitterly for a long while.
Shimin knelt and suckled at the emperor's breast, weeping bitterly for a long while.
吮上乳 states he suckled at the breast; "pretended" is not in the source.
Had Gaozu possessed King Wen's wisdom, the crown prince Taibo's virtue, and Taizong Zizang's selflessness, how could strife have arisen at all!
Had Gaozu possessed King Wen's wisdom, the Hidden Crown Prince Taibo's virtue, and Taizong Zizang's integrity, how could strife have arisen at all!
隱太子 is Jiancheng's posthumous title "Hidden Crown Prince"; the comparison is Jiancheng to Taibo and Taizong to Zizang.
Founders who establish dynasties set the pattern their heirs follow; did not the successions of Zhongzong, Ruizong, Suzong, and Daizong draw their justification from this very precedent?
Founders who establish dynasties set the pattern their heirs follow; did not the successions of Zhongzong, Xuanzong (Minghuang), Suzong, and Daizong draw their justification from this very precedent?
明 refers to Minghuang, i.e. Xuanzong, not Ruizong.

On wuchen, Yuwen Shiji was appointed crown prince household steward; Changsun Wuji and Du Ruhui were named left assistants to the heir; Gao Shilian and Fang Xuanling were named right assistants to the heir; Yuchi Jingde was made Left Weilü; Cheng Zhijie was made Right Weilü; Yu Shinan was made palace secretary; Chu Liang was made gentleman attendant; and Yao Silian was made study horse.

On wuchen, Yuwen Shiji was appointed crown prince household steward; Changsun Wuji and Du Ruhui were named left assistants to the heir; Gao Shilian and Fang Xuanling were named right assistants to the heir; Yuchi Jingde was made Commandant of the Left Guard; Cheng Zhijie was made Commandant of the Right Guard; Yu Shinan was made palace secretary; Chu Liang was made gentleman attendant; and Yao Silian was made Librarian of the Crown Prince.
左衛率/右衛率 and 洗馬 were left as transliteration ("Weilü") or a literal calque ("study horse").
On xinsi, Youzhou Grand Area Commander Li Yuan, King of Lujiang, rebelled; Right Leading Army General Wang Jun'guo killed him and sent his head.
On xinsi, Youzhou Grand Area Commander Li Yuan, King of Lujiang, rebelled; Right Leading Army General Wang Junkuo killed him and sent his head.
君廓 is romanized Junkuo; "Jun'guo" misreads 廓.
On xinsi, Jingzhou circuit campaigning commander Yuchi Jingde fought the Turks at Jingyang and routed them, capturing their irkin Ashina Shide Wumochuo and taking more than a thousand heads.
On xinsi, Jingzhou circuit campaigning commander Yuchi Jingde fought the Turks at Jingyang and routed them, capturing their irkin Ashide Wumochuo and taking more than a thousand heads.
阿史德 is the Ashide clan, distinct from Ashina; the draft inserts "Ashina".
Tang Lin was Study Horse Lingze's nephew.
Tang Lin was the nephew of Tang Lingze.
令則 is Tang Lingze; "Study Horse" is not in this sentence.

When Zheng reached Ci Prefecture, he met prefectural officers escorting in bonds the former crown prince's Qianniu guard Li Zhian and the Prince of Qi's guard commander Li Shihang bound for the capital. Zheng said, "From the day I received my commission, those of the former palace and the Prince of Qi's household were all pardoned and not to be questioned;
千牛 is the Qianniu (Thousand Oxen) guard office, not "thousand-bolt".
He then imprisoned Sili in the Secretariat.
He then imprisoned Sili in the Chancellery.
門下省 is the Chancellery, not the Secretariat.
